msg: My biggest piece of advice is to get into a rhythm of pressing s or k and then waiting until you get to the forest before pressing the space bar.  I kept pressing it too soon and then gazing at the forest like a numpty until it went "TOO SLOW".  Also don't be distracted by the mushrooms themselves it took me a while to realise I could pick a huge bunch and nothing happened to the score.  Go havea drink and get comfortable now, switch off any distractions, because you can't pause it.I have zero idea which gnomes gave the most mushrooms.  The hat shape changes as well as the colour.  Good luck!
